opportunities.title: Nursery
opportunities.description: We are looking to update the old side chapel into a nursery while retaining a space for mothers during Mass. Donations and volunteers are welcome.

opportunities.title: Lector Sign-up
opportunities.description: Proclaim the Scriptures and lead the Prayers of the Faithful during Mass. Training and scheduling support are provided for new lectors.

opportunities.title: Usher Sign-up
opportunities.description: Ushers welcome parishioners, help people find seats in the pews—especially when the church is full—and assist with passing the offertory basket during Mass.

opportunities.title: Altar Server Sign-up
opportunities.description: Serve at the altar during Mass. Altar servers assist the priest with liturgical functions such as carrying the Book of the Gospels, presenting the chalice, and other sacred items. Training is provided for all new servers, and adults and children (typically 4th grade and up) are both welcome.

opportunities.title: Music Ministry Sign-up
opportunities.description: Help lead the parish in sung prayer. We welcome people interested in joining the choir, serving as an instrumentalist, or becoming a cantor.

opportunities.title: Wednesday Night Supper
opportunities.description: Sponsor a Wednesday supper for $200 per week, or sign up to help with grocery pick-up, food prep, serving, or cleanup. Every Wednesday during the school year.
opportunities.landingPageDescription: Every Wednesday during the school year, our parish family gathers for supper from 5:30-6:00 PM before Faith Formation classes. Sponsor a week for $200, or sign up to help with grocery pick-up, food prep, serving, or cleanup.

opportunities.title: Youth Ministry Mentors
opportunities.description: Guide high school students in their faith journey as a small-group leader.

opportunities.title: Connect Groups
opportunities.description: Join a welcoming small-group community for prayer, fellowship, and Gospel-centered discussion.
opportunities.landingPageDescription: Connect Groups are small communities where parishioners gather for prayer, fellowship, and faith-filled conversation. They help us grow in friendship, support one another, and bring the Gospel into everyday life.

opportunities.title: Wednesday Faith Formation
opportunities.description: Help form the faith of our parish children as a catechist or classroom helper, or register a participant for Wednesday Faith Formation.
opportunities.landingPageDescription: Our Wednesday Faith Formation program helps children and families grow in the Catholic faith. Share your interest in serving as a catechist or helper, or request information about registering a participant.

opportunities.title: Group Studies
opportunities.description: Explore the Bible, Catholic teaching, and spiritual growth with a parish study group.
opportunities.landingPageDescription: Group Studies invite parishioners to explore Scripture, Catholic teaching, and spiritual formation in a prayerful, reflective setting. These seasonal studies help us deepen our relationship with Christ and one another.

opportunities.title: Annual Parish Picnic
opportunities.description: Help host our largest community event of the year.

opportunities.title: St. Vincent de Paul Food Drive
opportunities.description: Help sort and distribute food donations to local families in need.

opportunities.title: Altar Society
opportunities.description: The women of the parish care for the sacred linens, altar vessels, flowers, and decorations of our church. A beautiful way to serve the Lord through care of His house.

opportunities.title: Knights of Columbus
opportunities.description: The Knights of Columbus is the world's largest Catholic fraternal service organization. Our local council serves Saint Thérèse parish through charitable works, faith formation support, and community fellowship.

opportunities.title: Catholic Daughters of the Americas
opportunities.description: Join us for prayer, fellowship, and planning charitable works.
